shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Depth for calendar and city dialogs.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Background, text, and border state changes; disabled by reduced-motion preference.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Save availability or confirm a calendar import.

narrative.overview: A restrained workspace makes the same instant legible across cities. Deep teal marks selection and actions; fine rules keep dense calendar information organized. This is descriptive documentation of the implemented interface, not a record of user approval.

rules.name: Preserve the instant
rules.body: Changing the viewing city changes its display, not the underlying event time.

rules.name: Readable comparison
rules.body: Keep the three default city comparisons and primary actions visible in the desktop panel.

dos: Use named time zones for selected-date conversion.
Keep selected, saved, imported, and current-time states visually distinct.
Respect reduced motion and visible keyboard focus.
donts: Do not fabricate connected calendars or events.
Do not use decorative imagery inside the working calendar.
